BondSettings.description:
Bonding configuration

The ports are given in `portConnections` or, in the deprecated form, in `ports`. When both are
given, `ports` is ignored.

options.description: Bonding options, separated by spaces (e.g., "miimon=100 primary=eth0")

portConnections.description:
Ports of the controller. When neither this list nor `ports` is given, the current ports
are left alone.

ports.description:
Interface names or IDs of the ports of the controller.

DEPRECATED: replaced by `portConnections`, which also takes names. It keeps working, and it
is still reported for the clients that read it. When both lists are given,
`portConnections` is used and this one is ignored.

BridgeSettings.description:
Bridge configuration

The ports are given in `portConnections` or, in the deprecated form, in `ports`. When both are
given, `ports` is ignored.

forwardDelay.description: Spanning Tree Protocol forward delay, in seconds

helloTime.description: Spanning Tree Protocol hello time, in seconds

maxAge.description: Spanning Tree Protocol maximum message age, in seconds

portConnections.description:
Ports of the controller. When neither this list nor `ports` is given, the current ports
are left alone.

ports.description:
Interface names or IDs of the ports of the controller.

DEPRECATED: replaced by `portConnections`, which also takes names. It keeps working, and it
is still reported for the clients that read it. When both lists are given,
`portConnections` is used and this one is ignored.

priority.description: Spanning Tree Protocol priority (lower values are 'better')

stp.description: Whether the Spanning Tree Protocol is enabled or not

oneOf.description: The network is behind a captive portal and cannot reach the full internet.
The network is connected but it has no access to the full internet.
The network is connected and it has access to the full internet.

anonymousIdentity.description: Anonymous identity string for EAP authentication methods

caCertPassword.description: Password string for CA certificate if it is encrypted

clientCertPassword.description: Password string for client certificate if it is encrypted

identity.description: Identity string, often for example the user's login name

password.description: Password string used for EAP authentication

peapLabel.description: Force the use of the new PEAP label during key derivation

peapVersion.description: Which PEAP version is used when PEAP is set as the EAP method in the 'eap' property

privateKeyPassword.description: Password string for private key if it is encrypted

IpInet.description: An IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) with prefix length in CIDR notation

MatchSettings.description:
Match settings

Identifies the network interface to apply the connection settings to.

driver.description: A list of driver names to match

interface.description: A list of interface names to match

kernel.description: A list of kernel command line arguments to match

path.description: A list of paths to match against the ID_PATH udev property of devices

NetworkConnection.description:
Represents the configuration details for a network connection

The ports of a bond or a bridge are nested in its controller, as [PortConnection]s.

autoconnect.description: Specifies if the connection should automatically connect

bond.description: Bonding settings if part of a bond

bridge.description: Bridge settings if part of a bridge

customMacAddress.description:
Custom MAC address of the connection's interface

Can also be 'preserve', 'permanent', 'random' or 'stable'.

dnsSearchList.description: List of search domains for DNS resolution

dnsSearchlist.description: List of search domains for DNS resolution

gateway4.description: Gateway IP address for the IPv4 connection

gateway6.description: Gateway IP address for the IPv6 connection

id.description: Unique identifier for the network connection

ignoreAutoDns.description: Specifies whether to ignore automatically assigned DNS settings

interface.description: Network interface associated with the connection

macAddress.description: MAC address of the connection's interface

match.description: Match settings for the network connection

method4.description:
IPv4 method used for the network connection

Defaults to 'auto'.

method6.description:
IPv6 method used for the network connection

Defaults to 'auto'.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for the connection

nameservers.description: List of DNS server IP addresses

persistent.description: Specifies whether the connection should be persisted or not

status.description: Current status of the network connection

NetworkConnections.description:
Collection of connections.

It only holds the root connections: the ports of a bond or a bridge are nested inside the
`portConnections` list of their controller. Use [`Self::flatten`] to go through all of them.

PortConnection.description:
A port of a bond or a bridge, nested in its controller.

It is a connection without IP settings, as its controller holds the IP configuration, but with
the settings it has as a port. Unknown fields are rejected, so that IP settings given to a port
are not silently ignored.

autoconnect.description: Specifies if the connection should automatically connect

bond.description: Bonding settings, for a port that is a bond itself

bridge.description: Bridge settings, for a port that is a bridge itself

customMacAddress.description:
Custom MAC address of the connection's interface

Can also be 'preserve', 'permanent', 'random' or 'stable'.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the network connection

When it is omitted, the port refers to the connection bound to its interface, or gets the
interface name as its ID.

interface.description: Network interface associated with the connection

macAddress.description: MAC address of the connection's interface

match.description: Match settings for the network connection

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for the connection

persistent.description: Specifies whether the connection should be persisted or not

port.description:
Settings that this connection has because it is a port of its controller

Which ones apply depends on the kind of controller.

status.description: Current status of the network connection

anyOf.description:
Interface name or ID of a connection.

It is a shorthand for `{ "interface": "<name>" }`: it refers to the connection with that
interface name or ID, and a new Ethernet connection is created when there is none.

PortSettings.description:
Settings a connection has because of its membership in a controller.

Unlike the other sections, these do not describe the device itself but the role it plays in
the bond or bridge it belongs to. Which settings apply depends on the kind of controller.

pathCost.description: Port cost used by the Spanning Tree Protocol (bridge ports only)

priority.description: Port priority used by the Spanning Tree Protocol (bridge ports only)

StateSettings.description:
Network general settings for the installation like enabling wireless, networking and
allowing to enable or disable the copy of the network settings to the
target system

copyNetwork.description: Whether the network configuration should be copied to the target system

networkingEnabled.description: Whether the network should be enabled

wirelessEnabled.description: Whether the wireless should be enabled

oneOf.description: Reorder Ethernet headers to make packets look less like VLAN packets
GARP VLAN Registration Protocol - dynamically register/deregister VLANs
Allow changing master device while connection is active
Multiple VLAN Registration Protocol - next generation of GVRP

band.description: Frequency band of the wireless network

bssid.description: Only allow connection to this mac address

channel.description: Wireless channel of the wireless network

groupAlgorithms.description: A list of group/broadcast encryption algorithms

hidden.description: Indicates that the wireless network is not broadcasting its SSID

pairwiseAlgorithms.description: A list of pairwise encryption algorithms

pmf.description: Indicates whether Protected Management Frames must be enabled for the connection

wpaProtocolVersions.description: A list of allowed WPA protocol versions

connections.description: Connections to use in the installation
